full_prompt_en: A square old-master-style oil painting surveys a busy small town from a slightly elevated position. At the lower left, a short stone bridge arches over dark green water. Several white sheep cluster beside it on the near bank, while a small black-and-white dog crosses the pale open ground. A group of cattle and handlers gathers beyond the bridge. The right half is dominated by a tall warm stone building with steep red roofs, projecting windows and a large arched entrance. People stand inside and around that dark opening, some gathered at a small table. At the lower right, women in pale dresses and muted red garments arrange baskets and produce near the wall. The narrow street continues between the building and leafy trees toward smaller houses and a distant spire. More tiny figures occupy that route, so the whole settlement feels active despite the modest scale of each individual. The picture is full of carefully separated miniature actions, yet the bridge, arch and winding street keep the arrangement readable. Warm brick, ochre and rust tones dominate the architecture, while olive green foliage and cool water relieve the dense earth palette. Soft daylight brightens the central ground and pale animals, then falls away into the archway and shaded trees. Fine, controlled brushwork describes masonry, clothing and leaves, with gentle atmospheric softening in the far town. The composition moves from water and bridge through the market and under the building arch, joining everyday exchange to an intricate network of built forms and small figures.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形古典油画从略高处俯看繁忙的小镇。左下方一座短石桥跨过深绿水面。几只白羊聚在近岸桥边，一只黑白小狗横穿浅色空地。桥后还有一群牛和赶牲口的人。右半幅由一幢暖石色高楼主导，陡峭红屋顶、凸出的窗和大拱入口清楚可见。人们站在深色入口内外，有些聚在小桌旁。右下方，穿浅色裙和低饱和红衣的妇女在墙边摆弄篮子与农产。狭窄街道从房屋与多叶树木之间继续前行，通向更小房舍和远处尖塔。更多微小人物占据这条路线，因此整座聚落在每个人物都很小的情况下仍显活跃。画中有许多仔细分开的微型活动，但石桥、拱门和弯曲街道使布局仍清楚。暖砖、赭色和锈色主导建筑，橄榄绿树叶和冷水色缓解密集土色调。柔日光照亮中央地面和浅色牲畜，向拱门与树阴里逐渐暗下。细致受控的笔触描绘砌石、衣服和叶片，远处镇景带轻柔空气软化。构图从水和桥走过集市，再进入房屋拱下，把日常交易连到繁复建筑和细小人物的网络中。
style_prompt_en: The image has a finely detailed oil-painted surface with small controlled marks, soft atmospheric distance and a warm aged palette. Brick red, ochre, brown and muted gold form dense stacked masses, set against olive foliage and narrow cool green passages. Many miniature incidents occupy the frame, but larger arches, diagonals and vertical facades give them order. Near edges are precise enough to separate tiny forms; farther edges soften into a subdued haze. The light is broad daylight, lifting pale central areas while deep openings and tree cover hold concentrated shadow. Textures vary across rough masonry, foliage and cloth without becoming uniformly sharp. Space recedes through overlapping clusters and a winding route, while the elevated viewpoint lets foreground and distance remain visible together. The composition feels busy but stable, with warm architectural weight balanced by small cool intervals and a calm lower area. Its character comes from patient miniature description and coherent tonal structure.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有细节精密的油画表面，细小受控的笔痕、柔和的空气远方与暖古旧调色共同出现。砖红、赭、褐和低饱和金色形成密集堆叠团块，橄榄色叶丛与狭窄冷绿色段落同它们相对。许多微型活动占满画面，较大的拱形、斜线和竖向立面仍赋予秩序。近处边缘足以分开细小形体，远方边缘则软化进低调薄雾。光是宽泛日光，抬亮中央浅色区域，深洞口和树荫保留浓影。粗砌石、树叶和布料各有肌理，却没有平均地变得锐利。空间通过重叠形体群和蜿蜒路线后退，高视点让前景与远方同时可见。构图繁忙但稳定，暖建筑重量由少量冷色间隔和安静下方区域平衡。其特征来自耐心的微型描写与连贯的明暗结构。
theme_en: Villagers, livestock and a stone bridge fill a small riverside market beneath red-roofed townhouses
theme_zh: 村民、牲畜与石桥挤满红顶联排房屋下的河边小集市
name: Frans Francken the Younger
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
